This is used because the companion Joukan (上巻) guide (route_joukan.json) already spends its own Continue on the 瑠璃亜編 branch, so 闇の王編 is reached independently here. Per mmitsuru's geoooka.htm, the Ooka Report is a legitimate, non-canon-affecting way to jump straight into any Gekan route's opening scene; it does not affect the in-game completion percentage. xneo.jp's Gekan page does not document the Ooka Report mechanic at all (it assumes the player already continued from a specific Joukan ending), so jpGuide1 is empty for this step group. This shortest path keeps starting BLOOD level at 0.

Editorial checkpoint after the final shared B.S.S. of the Ending 12 / Ending 23 pair. xneo.jp's Ending 12 entry lists one extra plain line ('父さん……') here that its Ending 23 entry does not list; the next detour below follows Ending 12's own listing exactly as documented, including that line, without assuming it is also part of Ending 23's path.

First step of a detour toward xneo.jp's Ending 12 (闇の王編). This 父さん…… line is listed by xneo.jp's Ending 12 entry immediately after 父さんの…… but is not listed at all in its Ending 23 entry, making it the first documented point of difference between the two.
badEndPath: エンディング12「闇の王編」

enGuide: Per xneo.jp this completes Ending 12.

simpleJp: BLOODレベル確認：85以上が必要
jpGuide1: 闘って道を開くんだ……！（BLOODレベルが85以上の場合）
enGuide: BLOOD level must be 85 or higher at this final choice for this chain to lead to Ending 23 instead of falling back to the lower-BLOOD Ending 12/13-style outcomes documented earlier in this guide.

simpleJp: BLOODレベル確認：100以上が必要（ゲーム終了時）
jpGuide1: 【ゲームが終了した時】（BLOODレベルが100以上の場合）
enGuide: xneo.jp states the final requirement loosely as BLOOD 100 or higher at the moment the game concludes. mmitsuru's B.S.S./flag documentation for the textually-similar chain covered earlier in this guide is more precise about an equivalent moment, requiring BLOOD to hit exactly 100 at the exact instant 正夫 dies (too early produces mmitsuru's unrelated End21; too late/insufficient produces mmitsuru's End22「全ては闇に」). Neither source gives a tap-by-tap checklist precise enough to guarantee hitting the target exactly, so keep every B.S.S. trigger from this entire route in mind and tap all of them on this final run-through to maximize BLOOD level before this point.

simpleJp: 闇の王編（エンディング23）
jpGuide1: エンディング23～闇の王編～
enGuide: Route complete. xneo.jp lists this as its own Ending 23, headed ～闇の王編～. mmitsuru's archived geend23.htm page explicitly labels its own (textually different, 'う……うん' prefixed) chain 'End 23「闇の王編」', confirming both sources agree this exact route is named 闇の王編 for its main conclusion even though they reach a same-named label via two structurally different documented paths (see the notes throughout this guide on that disagreement). This is the route's main/final ending; the guide does not continue into another route from here.
